name: com.theemptylegindex/empty-leg-index
title: Empty Leg Index
description: Search UK and Europe empty legs. Enquire or set a route alert. No booking or payment.

tools.name: search_empty_legs
tools.description: Search empty-leg private jet flights currently published for the UK and Europe. A country or region matches when either airport is in that place. Prices are indicative, copied from the publishing source, and are not a quote. Each row includes the source name, the source URL, and fetchedAt, which is when this index collected the row. The result includes stale (true when lastSuccessAt is older than 36 hours, or ELI_STALE_HOURS) and lastSuccessAt, the time of the last successful fetch. An empty list means nothing published matches. It does not mean the route cannot be chartered. This tool does not book a flight and does not take payment.

origin.description: Departure only. City, airport name, or IATA or ICAO code, for example LTN or London. Omit to leave that end open.

destination.description: Arrival only. City, airport name, or IATA or ICAO code, for example NCE or Nice. Omit to leave that end open.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example GB or FR. A leg matches when either airport is in that country.

region.description: Either "uk" (United Kingdom) or "europe" (this index's UK and Europe set). A leg matches when either airport is in the region.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive first departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Compared with the published date, not a time of day.

aircraftCategory.description: One of very-light, light, midsize, super-midsize, heavy, ultra-long-range, turboprop. Aircraft this index cannot classify are "unspecified" and do not match a category filter.

maxPrice.description: Highest published amount to include. Non-negative number, in the leg's own currency unless currency is also set. Legs with no numeric price are left out when this is set.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code such as EUR or GBP. Applied only together with maxPrice: legs priced in another currency are left out. Ignored when maxPrice is omitted.

tools.name: get_leg
tools.description: Return one published empty leg by id, including the route, date, aircraft, indicative price or price band, each source name and source URL, and fetchedAt (when this index collected the row, not a live quote). An unknown id returns an error and no leg. This does not hold or book the seat.

id.description: Id of a published leg, as returned by search_empty_legs. Example: leg-ltn-nce.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List every configured empty-leg source: its id, public page, whether it is enabled, and the last refresh result (when it was attempted, whether that attempt worked, how many valid legs it yielded, and the failure text when it failed). A disabled source is not fetched. A source named in ELI_DISABLED_SOURCES is paused. The result includes stale and lastSuccessAt for the index as a whole. This is the census of this index, not a booking directory. Call it with an empty object.

inputSchema.description: No arguments. Pass an empty object.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Store an enquiry about one published leg and return a reference. The result includes the sentence "No booking or payment made; the operator will contact you / enquire via their link" and the operator or broker's own booking URL. It does not reserve a seat, charge a card, or confirm the flight still exists. Call it only after the person has asked to enquire and has given their name, email, passenger count, and agreement to be contacted. consent must be the boolean true.

leg_id.description: Id of a published leg, as returned by search_empty_legs. Example: leg-ltn-nce.

name.description: Name of the person who wants to be contacted. 1 to 200 characters.

email.description: Email address of that person. The operator or broker is who follows up.

passengers.description: How many people would fly. A whole number from 1 to 19. This does not reserve seats.

notes.description: Optional note, at most 2000 characters. Omit it when there is nothing to add.

consent.description: Must be the boolean true. That means the person agreed to be contacted about this leg. Any other value is rejected, and the enquiry is not stored.

tools.name: set_alert
tools.description: Store a free email alert for new empty legs on a route. Set an origin, a destination, or both. Each end is an airport (city, name, or IATA or ICAO code) or a country (ISO code or English name, for example GB or France). originCountry and destinationCountry name the country for that end when you want it on its own. dateFrom and dateTo are an optional inclusive window, YYYY-MM-DD. maxPrice is an optional highest published amount, in the leg's own currency unless currency is also set. email is the address that receives the alert. consent must be the boolean true, and only after the person has asked to be emailed. The watch is stored as pending and a confirmation link is emailed. No alert is sent until that link is opened. Each alert email includes an unsubscribe link, and a delete-my-data link removes every watch stored for that address. This does not book a seat and it does not take payment. A leg is included only when every source on it is enabled. Villiers is never included.

origin.description: Departure airport or country. An airport is a city, a name, or an IATA or ICAO code, for example LTN or London Luton. A country is an ISO code or an English name, for example GB or France. Two letters are always a country. Omit this when originCountry carries the country, or when only the destination is set.

destination.description: Arrival airport or country, in the same form as origin. Omit this when destinationCountry carries the country, or when only the origin is set.

originCountry.description: Country of departure on its own, as an ISO code or an English name, for example FR or France. A leg matches when the departure airport is in that country. Use this when origin is an airport and you also want to name the country, or instead of origin.

destinationCountry.description: Country of arrival on its own, as an ISO code or an English name. A leg matches when the arrival airport is in that country.

dateFrom.description: Optional inclusive first departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for no start.

dateTo.description: Optional inclusive last departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for no end.

maxPrice.description: Optional highest published amount to include. Non-negative number, in the leg's own currency unless currency is also set. Legs with no numeric price are left out when this is set.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code such as EUR or GBP. Applied only together with maxPrice. Omit it when maxPrice is omitted.

email.description: Email address that receives the confirmation and, after that, the alerts. One address, no spaces.

consent.description: Must be the boolean true. That means the person asked to be emailed about this route. Any other value is rejected, and the watch is not stored.
